cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought a blanket. You remembered my heater-reset lesson, but not my lesson about keeping yourself warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can fix the heater. Leave the blanket; I am freezing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent diagnosis. Now can you say you still need a little help from the person who taught you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you to tuck the blanket round me while I work. You can leave the switches to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's better. I'll do the tucking; you can practice that sentence whenever you get cold without me.
